decisions.reason: Using the provided logo and branding does not change the master site's role, booking configuration, national scope, or positioning.

The logo decision does not alter the competitor-reference approach, visual style, layout characteristics, navigation style, or cross-location design consistency; the specific brand assets remain owned by the source Requirement.
The reusable-template Requirement already requires consistent SMASH ROOM branding, and the supplied logo does not change its reuse strategy, template basis, or redesign rule.
Logo and branding usage does not change the mobile-friendly responsive-design requirement.
The branding decision does not change location options, selector behavior, or routing destinations.
Dedicated location pages and consistent cross-location branding remain valid unchanged; the exact logo asset is represented by the source Brand Identity Requirement.
The requirement to preserve Bay Area SEO during the branding transition remains unchanged by selection of the supplied logo.
The logo decision does not change Seattle's coming-soon mode, page sections, button label, or opening transition.
Brand asset usage does not change the booking platform, booking host, or Seattle booking activation behavior.
Using the supplied logo has no effect on the required isolation of bookings, revenue, customer data, analytics, memberships, gift cards, or staff access.
The branding decision does not change the VIP email signup behavior or its button label.
Using the supplied logo and branding does not change the homepage section list or the requirement to expose offerings on the homepage.
